RememberPast modals
should have + V3надо было (но не сделал): I should have checked the map.
shouldn’t have + V3не надо было (но сделал): I shouldn’t have made up my experience.
must have + V3наверняка (≈95%): The streets are wet. It must have rained.
might / could have + V3возможно (≈50%): He might have left his phone at home.
can’t have + V3не может быть (≈0%): He can’t have gone far — his coffee is hot.
could have + V3мог бы (но не сделал): You could have told me!
